piece.headline: CHANDRU RUNS OFF WITH IT AS HAALAND GOES MISSING
piece.standfirst: Chandru sets the pace with Manager of the Week, while 18 managers hand the armband to a Haaland blank.
piece.big_picture: Chandru is top of the pile after week one, with Aashiv the nearest rival. 18 managers armed Haaland and he delivered 2. The lead is early days, but nobody else has a head start like this.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Pishu left 23 points on the bench, the most in the league. His subs had a better afternoon than his starting 11. Time to check the team sheet twice.
piece.one_to_watch: Ravi Mahtani and Rohan are split by just 1 point on the Gold spots line. If one gets the armband right next week, the gap could open up quickly.

winners.name: Chandru
winners.verdict: Top of the league by a distance, Bench Boost or not. That was a statement of a week. Skill, with a dash of nerve.

winners.name: Aashiv
winners.verdict: Second place with a Bench Boost that added nothing. The points came from the starters. Solid, sensible, and a proper chaser.

winners.name: Vinesh
winners.verdict: Third, and no chip needed. Quiet, clean and effective. That is how you start a season without anyone noticing until it's too late.

losers.name: Bella
losers.verdict: Wooden Spoon on opening week. Rough, but it's only week one and there's a long way to climb. Plenty of time.

losers.name: Ravi Bhojwani
losers.verdict: A tough start, well short of the average. Nothing here that a better week 2 can't start to fix.

losers.name: Naresh
losers.verdict: Well below the pack, and no chip to blame. Not the start he wanted, but there are 37 gameweeks left to repair it.
